title: pick_from_row crashed with int(NaN) when a candidate's pitcher_id was missing (preview pick), fixed 5/15
missing_evidence: cron.log (B1) for the 03:00 chain on and before 2026-05-15 showing `bts preview` failing with 'cannot convert float NaN to integer' in pick_from_row

bts-scheduler journal 2026-05-11..05-15 (B1 journal_*_retained.txt) for any lineup check that failed in pick_from_row, and the matching pick files (B1 data/picks) - to tell a preview-only failure from a scheduler selection failure
tier_reason: if only the 3 AM preview failed, the effect was a missing morning preview (display, B); if a scheduler selection hit a NaN pitcher_id, a lineup check produced no pick (delivery risk, A) - which occurred is unknown

contract.text: A candidate row with an unknown (NaN/NA) probable pitcher still yields a pick with pitcher_id None instead of an exception.

mechanism.text: pick_from_row used `int(row['pitcher_id']) if row.get('pitcher_id') else None`; NaN is truthy, so a missing pitcher_id reached int(NaN) and raised ValueError, aborting pick creation for that run

watchdog.trigger: a preview or lineup-check run exits with an exception before writing the day's pick while games remain (cron.log / journal traceback), or the earliest pick game's cutoff approaches with no pick file
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the next run writes a pick for the day
